label: Q-01
title: The story-080 DeployMocks rehearsal omits the Antimatter phUSD mint grant that the mainnet script proves load-bearing, and the local verifier never calls autoAnnihilate, so the rehearsal cannot exercise V2's only reward path
fingerprintProvenance: Copied verbatim from reports/31/script-audits/stable-staker-v2-cutover/classified-findings.json (not recomputed). finding-manager cross-check: sha256(fingerprintBasis) reproduces it byte-for-byte.
description: Story 082 names DeployMocks' `_deployAntimatterAndStableStakerV2` + `_rehearseStableStakerCutover` as 'THE TEMPLATE for ordering and assertions'. The mainnet script adds `phUSD.setMinter(antimatter, true)` (Decision 3), because `Antimatter.annihilate` pays its antimatter half with `_phUSD.mint(recipient, amount)`. The executor showed with a negative control that autoAnnihilate otherwise reverts `phUSD: caller is not authorized to mint`. DeployMocks grants only `antimatter.setApprovedMinter(V2)` and `phUSD.setMinter(V2)`. Its local phUSD is `MockPhUSD`, whose `mint` requires `info.canMint && info.mintVersion == mintVersion`. `verify-stable-staker.sh` → `ClaimWithdrawStableStaker.s.sol` asserts `claimEnabled` is false and then withdraws, never calling `autoAnnihilate`. On anvil, the only reward path while `claimEnabled == false` therefore appears to revert, and no local test would notice. Story 082 Decision 3 flagged this as a follow-up, and at 1c1608c it is unfixed.
impact: The local rehearsal and dev environment (UI and integration testing of the V2 reward flow) diverge from mainnet on a load-bearing mint grant. Future edits to the mainnet cutover or V2 reward path get no local signal. The prior run-30 verdict that the V1→V2 exception is 'verified WORKING' did not cover autoAnnihilate. There is no mainnet impact: mainnet preview smoke tests autoAnnihilate, and this audit confirmed all three pools on the fork.

classification.assetImpact: None on mainnet (the fork confirmed autoAnnihilate works on all three pools under the mainnet wiring). Local rehearsal/dev only: the Antimatter reward path on anvil likely reverts because the phUSD mint grant is omitted, and the local verifier never exercises autoAnnihilate.
classification.likelihood: n/a - the anvil revert was reasoned from code (grep shows no setMinter(antimatter) in DeployMocks; MockPhUSD.mint requires canMint) but NOT executed
classification.assumptions: The DeployMocks anvil path uses MockPhUSD as Antimatter's phUSD (DeployMocks.s.sol:1865, :211).

severityRationale: Proposed Low by the scanner, but held at QA because the core claim (the anvil autoAnnihilate revert) is unverified and there is no mainnet impact. Upgrade to Low once a local run confirms the revert. Limb 2 (the verifier never calls autoAnnihilate) overlaps open ledger F-03 c476a12b04fa (test:stable-staker); the human should decide whether it folds there. Limb 1 (the missing grant) is new.
recommendation: In `_deployAntimatterAndStableStakerV2`, add `phUSD.setMinter(address(antimatter), true)` with a read-back at the current mintVersion. Extend `verify-stable-staker.sh` / `ClaimWithdrawStableStaker.s.sol` with a stake + `evm_increaseTime` (short) + `autoAnnihilate` step that asserts phUSD received > 0 and Antimatter owed was consumed. First confirm by running the story-080 dev rehearsal and calling autoAnnihilate on anvil; record the exact revert string.
evidence: DeployMocks.s.sol:1880 `antimatter.setApprovedMinter(address(stableStakerV2), true);` and :1890 `phUSD.setMinter(address(stableStakerV2), true);`; `grep setMinter(address(antimatter)` over script/DeployMocks.s.sol returns nothing; :1865 `antimatter.setPhUSD(IFlaxStaker(address(phUSD)))` with `MockPhUSD public phUSD` (:211); src/mocks/MockPhUSD.sol:48 `require(info.canMint && info.mintVersion == mintVersion, "Not authorized to mint");`. Mainnet script CutoverStableStakerV2Mainnet.s.sol:441-446 grants it. Fork counter-check of the mainnet path (fork-logs/h-test_D_autoAnnihilateAllPools.log): `AA_FRESH|DOLA|ok`, `AA_FRESH|USDC|ok`, `AA_FRESH|USDe|ok`, plus a migrated staker on each pool ok. The anvil revert was NOT executed in this audit (reasoned from code).
